contexts.text: He fled away, crying, I am a Spirit... SE 2288.
That the infernal crew shall flee away at his presence. Signified. For when any infernal approaches a (celestial) Angel, he flees away at his presence... AC 6369:end.
Everything evil and false, thus the infernal crew, flees away to a great distance when good approaches, or an Angel who is in good. AC 8722:end.
At the bare idea of being reclothed with their earthly bodies they fled far away.
At the first view of the city in which I dwelt he fled away.
(He said), On seeing me the Angels fled away...
At the bare perception of Divine truth from Divine good the infernal Genii flee away...
That when evil Spirits perceive (anything from the heavenly Societies) they flee away.
The Spirits then fled away, crying that they could not endure so cadaverous an odour.
When I awoke, they seemed to flee away...
That the world of Spirits... flee away (from a single Angel).
The Spirits who were before around me fled away...
